asks: Is "a computer is a computer" a principle for every addition?
answer: Yes. A computer is a computer, whatever its system and whichever device runs it. Every addition is asked whether it is the same on every system and device, and which platform forces the difference if not.

sets.says: A computer is a computer, whatever its system and whichever device runs it. Differences are only those the platform forces.
sets.asks: Is it the same on every system and device? If not, which platform forces the difference?
